summary: baseline FSRS-7 (default init_w, --short --secs --recency, 8 epochs, Adam betas=(0.8, 0.85), lr=2e-2 cosine to 0)
Adam betas (0.8, 0.85) -> (0.9, 0.95); higher beta1 for smoother momentum, slightly higher beta2, gap preserved (~0.05)
reason: improvement -0.00032 < threshold 0.0001 (variant LL is worse than champion); (0.8, 0.85) preserved as champion

summary: w[25] clamp floor 2.5 -> 1.0 (40.2% of users hit floor at baseline); default 2.5 and L2 sigma 0.4053 unchanged
reason: improvement +0.00001 < threshold 0.0001. Freeing the bound let w[25] p01 drop 2.5->1.17 and hit_lo collapse 40.2%->0.4%, so the bound WAS active — but L2 prior toward default 2.5 (sigma=0.4053) is the real anchor, so net LL barely moved. Champion floor (2.5) restored.

summary: PENALTY_W_L2 0.5 -> 0.25 (relax L2 prior; iter 2 evidence suggested L2 anchored bound-saturated params)
reason: improvement -0.00012 < threshold 0.0001 (variant LL is WORSE). Relaxing L2 broadened p99 modestly (w[25] 2.81->2.95, w[26] p01 0.62->0.55) but did not reduce bound saturation (w[25] hit_lo still 40.1%, ~unchanged). Net LL got worse — the original L2 strength of 0.5 was actually preventing overfitting. PENALTY_W_L2 restored to 0.5.

summary: RECENCY_C0 0.25->0.10, RECENCY_C1 0.75->0.90 (downweight old reviews further; preserve newest weight=1.0)
reason: improvement +0.00040 > threshold 0.0001 (4x). Complexity unchanged. Improvement appears in both short_term (-0.00063) and long_term (-0.00050) splits — model generalizes better when older reviews are downweighted more aggressively. Again loss: 1.404->1.401. New champion at iter 4.

summary: RECENCY_C0 0.10->0.05, C1 0.90->0.95 (push recency further along axis that worked in iter 4)
reason: improvement +0.00001 < threshold 0.0001. The recency-weighting axis diminishing-returns past C0=0.10 — most of the gain was captured by iter 4. Iter 4 (C0=0.10) remains champion.

summary: LR 2e-2 -> 1e-2 (halve initial LR; testing whether iter 4 recency shift changed LR optimum)
reason: improvement -0.00056 < threshold 0.0001 (variant is markedly WORSE). Halving LR undertrained — cosine annealing from 1e-2 decays to 0 across 8 epochs, leaving the model far from its loss minimum. LR=2e-2 confirmed as a good initial rate. Original LR restored.

summary: cosine LR scheduler eta_min 0.0 -> 0.05 (keep LR non-zero at end of decay; tests whether cosine->0 leaves loss on the table)
reason: improvement +0.00006 < threshold 0.0001 (signal-noise). Direction matched iter 6 reversed: floor-at-5%-of-initial-LR moved LL the RIGHT way (vs iter 6 which destroyed +0.00056). Confirms cosine->0 endpoint leaves a small crumb on the table but eta_min=0.05 is too low a floor. Original scheduler restored. Follow-up: try eta_min=0.10-0.20, or warm restart / multistage decay.

summary: log-transform w[0..3]: store u=log(w) as the optimizer-visible param; CUDA still sees w via exp at boundary. Chain-rule dL/dw -> dL/du = dL/dw*w in train_iter and predict_test_set. Clipper bounds for first 4 -> log space.
reason: improvement +0.00005 < threshold 0.0001. Scale fix worked optically: |grad| on w[0] collapsed from 69.86 (linear, at champion) to 0.55 (log space here), a 127x reduction matching the chain factor w[0]~=0.07. But Adam was already adapting per-param via second-moment estimation; reparameterization just moved the optimum: w[0] median 0.07->0.044, w[3] p99 12.99->99.999 (ceiling-saturated for many users), w[1] stuck at default. LL unchanged. Champion unchanged at iter 4. Follow-up: tighten w[3] upper clamp (it ran away in log space), or try log-transform on w[0] only.

summary: AdamW weight_decay 0 -> 1e-4 (engage the decoupled L2-to-zero knob that has never been used)
reason: improvement +0.00001 < threshold 0.0001 (noise). Shrinkage of 1.6 percent over 8152 steps at lr=2e-2 is too gentle to budge against the L2-to-default prior. Param mean/median/percentiles indistinguishable from champion. Champion unchanged. Follow-up: try weight_decay 5e-4 or 1e-3 for stronger shrinkage, or use weight_decay together with relaxed L2 sigmas so the two priors do not fight.

summary: 500-step linear warmup multiplied on top of cosine LR schedule (motivated by w[0] |grad|~70, w[27] |grad|~40 -- Adam moments cold at step 0)
reason: improvement -0.00886 (deeply worse). 500 warmup steps == ~half of epoch 1 at sub-full LR; cosine decay over the remaining 7 epochs cannot recover the lost LR budget. Adams bias correction already handles cold moments; warmup was redundant AND destructive. Cosine schedule + bias correction is sufficient. Champion unchanged.

summary: PENALTY_W_L2 0.5 -> 1.0 (double L2-to-default prior strength; iter 3 weakening was worse, so test the other direction)
reason: improvement +0.00001 (noise). PENALTY_W_L2=0.5 is at or near the L2-strength optimum -- doubling has no effect. Combined with iter 3 evidence (halving made it WORSE), the prior strength axis is fully explored. Need to look elsewhere (per-param sigmas, model structure).

summary: Lower clip floor for w[11] (LT fail_d_exp) and w[20] (ST fail_d_exp) from 0.001 to 0.0; targets 36.8%/36.3% floor saturation. d^(-0)=1.0 safe.
reason: Improvement -0.0000024 < threshold 0.0001 (at noise floor). Floor change moved hit_lower 36.8 -> 46.9 pct (w[11]) and 36.3 -> 44.0 pct (w[20]); confirms ~10pp of users wanted below 0.001, but d^(-0.001) vs d^0 is structurally negligible (for d=10, ratio is 0.998 vs 1.0). The L2 prior (default 0.0049, sigma 0.0829) anchors well above 0 and is the actual dominating constraint. Next attack: weaken L2 prior on w[11]/w[20] or zero out the L2 default.

summary: Anchor fail_d_exp at 0: lower floor (0.001->0) AND L2 default (0.0049->0 for w[11], 0.0107->0 for w[20]). Make 0 the natural resting value.
reason: Improvement -0.0000082 (WORSE) < threshold. hit_lower 36.8 -> 57.8 pct (w[11]) and 36.3 -> 61.0 pct (w[20]); median dropped to ~0 for both. Removing the L2 anchor at 0.005 let weak-signal users drift to 0, hurting fit slightly. Confirms the L2 prior at 0.005 was load-bearing regularization (the small but non-zero d-dependence is useful on average). Lesson: do not strip useful priors when targeting bound saturation.
